properties.displayName: UAV S123 - Fixed-Wing Stall Induction (Airspeed/Control Surface Manipulation)
properties.description: UAVOpmode_CL에서 OpmodeField='airspeed_control_surface'인 레코드 중 ObservedValue(실측 대기속도)가 UAV_Threshold_List.MinAirspeed_ms(실속 최소속도 임계, FBW_MIN) 미만이고 Authorized=0(SByte)인 비인가 조작 탐지. 실제 컬럼: OpmodeField/ExpectedValue/ObservedValue/ChangedBy/Authorized(SByte). MITRE: T0806 Brute Force I/O (제어면/속도 명령을 비인가로 조작해 고정익 실속을 유도)
properties.query:
let alertWindow = 10m;
let minAirspeed = toscalar(
    _GetWatchlist('UAV_Threshold_List')
    | where ThresholdKey == 'MinAirspeed_ms'
    | project toreal(Value));
UAVOpmode_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
| where OpmodeField == 'airspeed_control_surface'
| extend ObservedAirspeed = toreal(ObservedValue)
| where ObservedAirspeed < minAirspeed and Authorized == 0
| extend TriggerReason = strcat("고정익_실속유도_비인가_", UAVId, "_속도:", tostring(ObservedAirspeed), "m/s<임계:", tostring(minAirspeed))
| project TimeGenerated, UAVId, OpmodeField, ExpectedValue, ObservedValue, ObservedAirspeed, ChangedBy, Authorized, Seq, TriggerReason
| order by TimeGenerated desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: UAV S123 - Fixed-Wing Stall Induction (Airspeed/Control Surface Manipulation) - {{UAVId}}
